name: Cotton Traders
known_for: Casual Clothing for Women and Men
notes: 2026-10-29 (coldwater-creek page run): US storefront in USD ('$ USD - United States'). Its dresses page lists dresses in its structured data (Metallic Textured V-Neck Tiered Maxi Dress, V-Neck Satin Maxi Dress, Velour Midi Dress) but every price there is 0 and the grid prices load by script (WebFetch saw an empty grid), so no price stored; sells_categories from its own dresses page.

International delivery page lists the United States, Canada and Australia among destinations; 'All international deliveries are exported from the UK and therefore you may have to pay import duties and taxes'; non-EU delivery aims for 7 working days. Rates $16.95/$22.95/$29.95 listed without saying which applies to the US. Banner 'FREE standard shipping on orders over $89*' not tied to the US, so free_shipping_min_usd left empty. Returns: 'within 60 days'; '$9.95 will be deducted from your refund to cover returns postage to our UK Distribution Centre'. Size chart: UK 8 (US 4) to UK 32 (US 28); no petite or tall. Wikipedia: founded 24 April 1987 by Fran Cotton and Steve Smith; HQ Altrincham, England; CorpAcq majority stake since May 2018.
